calibration.note: validation split does not contain classes ['Light', 'Light-Medium', 'Medium', 'Very Fair']; raw probabilities kept (calibration requires every class to appear in the calibration data)

selection_reason.note: highest person-grouped CV macro_f1 over the same folds; heuristic baseline kept separately as model zero

ablation.note: same folds/backend for every variant; the full set stays the deployed default unless a variant wins by a margin worth acting on

warnings: classes with zero support (metrics for them are vacuous): Light-Medium, Medium-Deep, Very Deep
classes with support < 5 (unstable metrics): Very Fair=4, Fair=4, Light=2, Medium=2, Deep=4
